challenge.title: The challenge in KSA
challenge.body: Threats against Saudi organizations are rising alongside digital adoption. National Cybersecurity Authority controls, the PDPL and sector regulators set clear expectations, while specialist security talent remains scarce and expensive.
points: A growing set of NCA controls to implement and evidence
Third parties and suppliers as an expanding attack surface

opportunity.title: The opportunity
opportunity.body: Treating security as architecture rather than a checklist reduces risk and audit effort at the same time. The Saudi cybersecurity market is expanding fast, with a strong preference for on-premise and in-Kingdom solutions.

capabilities.title: VAPT and red teaming

capabilities.body: Security in the delivery pipeline and across your supply chain.

capabilities.title: Certification readiness

vision2030.body: A secure and trusted cyberspace is a foundation for the digital economy, digital government and foreign investment.
